title: Weekly report writer
description: Turns the weekly job export into a short written report with charts, checks and week-over-week comparison.

spec.input: Weekly CSV export of completed jobs
spec.output: Written weekly report with key figures, charts and data checks

problem: Every Monday the operations manager exports last week's completed jobs, builds pivot tables by hand and writes a summary for the owners. It is slow, the numbers are easy to get wrong, and small problems like duplicate rows or missing ratings rarely get noticed.

steps.label: Input
steps.text: The weekly job export lands in a SharePoint folder as a CSV: one row per completed job.

steps.label: AI step
steps.text: Claude computes the totals from the rows, compares them with the 4-week average and writes a short report with charts.

steps.label: Check
steps.text: Duplicate job IDs, missing ratings and other data gaps are flagged, and the report states how many rows it used.

steps.label: Output
steps.text: The report lands in Outlook or a Teams channel for the owners every Monday morning.

stack.name: Claude
stack.role: Computes the figures, writes the report and picks the charts.

stack.name: Excel
stack.role: Source of the job export and the 4-week baseline.

stack.name: Power Automate
stack.role: Runs the report every Monday when the new export arrives.

stack.name: Outlook
stack.role: Delivers the report to the owners.

stack.name: Teams
stack.role: Posts the report in the operations channel.
